hooks.name: Daily Research Standup
hooks.description: Check tasks and plan the day

action.message: Read TASKS.md and help me plan my work session. 1) List tasks that are 'In Progress' or can be started (dependencies met). 2) For each available task, show me its 'Context Files' section so I know what to reference. 3) Ask which task I want to work on. When I choose, summarize the task's Why, Deliverables, and Context Files. Do NOT invent task status - only report what's in TASKS.md.

I completed an experiment and need to document it. Ask me: 1) Which task was this for? (e.g., Task 2.3) 2) What were the exact metric values? (Recall@10, NDCG@10, MRR) 3) What dataset subset did you use? 4) What did you learn? Then: A) Create experiment doc in experiments/exp_XXX.md following experiment-documentation.md template, B) Update the task's Outcomes section in TASKS.md, C) Tell me which other context files should be updated (e.g., RESEARCH_CONTEXT_KERNEL.md.md). Do NOT invent any metric values - only use what I provide.

hooks.name: Complete Task
hooks.description: Mark a task as done and update all context

action.message: I finished a task and need to update all documentation. Ask me: 1) Which task number? (e.g., 1.4) 2) What were the deliverables completed? 3) What are the outcomes to record? Then: A) Update the task status to '✅ Done' in TASKS.md, B) Fill in the Outcomes section for that task, C) Check if any context files listed in that task need updates (e.g., RESEARCH_CONTEXT_KERNEL.md.md, open_questions.md), D) Check if this unblocks other tasks and note them. Do NOT mark anything done that I don't confirm.

hooks.name: Summarize Paper
hooks.description: Add a paper to literature review

action.message: I want to add a paper to our literature review. I'll give you the paper details. Create a summary in papers/[YEAR]_[Title].md following the exact template in paper-analysis.md steering. After creating, tell me which tasks this paper might be relevant to (check TASKS.md context files). Only include information I provide - do NOT invent details.

hooks.name: Sync Decision Status
hooks.description: Update docs after a meeting or discussion

action.message: I had a meeting or discussion and need to update our docs. I'll tell you what was decided. Based ONLY on what I tell you, suggest updates to: 1) TASKS.md if task status changed, 2) RESEARCH_CONTEXT_KERNEL.md.md if decisions changed, 3) research_decisions/open_questions.md if questions were resolved. Do NOT assume any decisions I don't explicitly state.

Help me prepare for a supervisor meeting. Read TASKS.md and RESEARCH_CONTEXT_KERNEL.md.md, then generate: 1) Tasks completed since last update (only those marked Done), 2) Current blockers (from open_questions.md), 3) Questions we need supervisor input on. Base everything on the actual file contents - do NOT invent progress.
